findings.claim: The global ask-permission entries for ACDSL rule-file edits (Edit/Write on **/*.acdsl and acdsl/**) were removed with no full replacement, leaving repos without acdsl/policy.json, gated-mode repos (for ordinary rule files), and this free-mode repo itself with no interactive gate on a security-relevant edit surface.
findings.fix: Make the removal an explicit decision; at minimum keep a baseline ask (or deny) for repos where acdsl/policy.json is absent or mode free is only the un-declared default, so unadopted repos don't silently lose the gate.

findings.claim: GitChangedFiles splits git diff/ls-files output with strings.Fields, so any changed or untracked path containing a space is split into bogus paths and silently skipped by ruleDelta/CheckPolicy's rule-change detection.
findings.fix: Split the output on newlines and trim/filter empty lines instead of using strings.Fields.

findings.claim: The RunResult Subtype/Result fields, IsRunning() (subtype "started"), and the History() filter for started rows are dead code — no writer of results.jsonl ever emits subtype "started", only the unit test's synthetic fixture does.
findings.fix: Either wire an actual "started" marker write (e.g. in the wrapper templates before claude -p is invoked) or drop IsRunning() and the filtering loop until a producer exists.

findings.claim: The pre-existing doc comment for rootCause now sits above the newly inserted worktreeSessions function (which has its own doc comment), leaving rootCause undocumented and worktreeSessions with two unrelated comments.
findings.fix: Move the rootCause doc comment back above rootCause so each function carries its own comment.

findings.claim: installEnvPath is read via the bare relative path "install.env", so ExpandInstallMarkers silently falls back to DefaultPeekControlPort with no logging whenever the process cwd is not the repo root.
findings.fix: Resolve a repo-root-relative path once at startup instead of using a bare relative literal ad hoc.
